review_items.message: 'ö' (U+00F6 LATIN SMALL LETTER O WITH DIAERESIS) appears only 1 time(s) in this book, here in 'Königsberg,'.
review_items.expected_action: Look at the scan to confirm this character is printed; never change it automatically.

review_items.message: Page 141 has inline note callout(s) ['1', '2', '4', '5'] vs. labelled footnote(s) ['1', '2', '3', '4', '5'].
review_items.expected_action: Confirmed against scan as original compositor apparatus discrepancy (preserved per Rule 4).

review_items.message: Isolated 450-DPI TOTAL strip read ['Total estimate for the year will be . .', '£ 11,498 16 0'] vs. full-page pass ['Total estimate for the year will be', '£11,498', '16', '0']. Full-page decoding often self-reconciles totals to misread addends above.
review_items.expected_action: Confirmed against scan that full-page total row matches original print.
